scope.summary: Implement the wet layer stack (spec 13.22; PREQ-008/009): independent sweat, oil, and water/lube/saliva layers as clearcoat-style specular lobes (IOR ~1.33, low roughness defaults) with droplet/drip normal detail, coverage driven by region masks PLUS a vertex-paint attribute lane so wetness placement is paintable directly on the body, linked to the arousal controller for genital wetness ramping.
acceptance_criteria: Wet layers (sweat, oil, water/lube/saliva) implemented as clearcoat-style specular lobes with documented defaults (IOR ~1.33, low roughness) and optional droplet/drip normal detail (PREQ-008).

Placement: region masks plus a vertex-paint attribute lane make wetness paintable directly on body regions (genital wetness, chest sweat, facial saliva) and the paint persists with the body (PREQ-009).
The MT-559 arousal controller ramps genital-region wetness through an explicit disable-able link.
Per-lane bake behavior documented and tested: wet state flattens into export maps or exports as a separate wetness mask depending on the export profile.
scope.risk_if_missed: Wet skin is an adult-production staple present in nearly every shot (sweat, lube, saliva strings); without a toggleable wet stack with paintable placement, users rebuild custom shader graphs per scene - the exact anti-pattern PREQ-008 names.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

target_entries: Tailor UserManual > BodyKit skin, UVs, and materials

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: This MT owns authoritative, job, or external-tool lifecycle events and must project the same event_id, run_id, actor_id, and correlation_id from EventLedger into Flight Recorder.
This MT must wire the shared internal_diagnostics API for its native, job, device, solver-run, or DCC failure modes with bounded structured evidence.
The owning native shell or scheduled job supplies Palmistry coverage; this MT must preserve operation identity and recovery handles.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

required_changes_before_execution: Consume the signed technical refinement, canonical command/surface registries, classified HBR tiers, and task-oriented UserManual contract before execution.
